name: Moon Bloom
summary: Three pink flowers grow and bloom under a full moon, with fireflies, falling petals and a note
about: A layered night meadow where three glowing pink flowers rise from swaying grass, unfold their leaves and burst open petal by petal, while clouds drift past the moon, shooting stars cross the sky and fireflies wander. A note with a name of your choice floats in word by word once they bloom. Good for a romantic page, a greeting card or a soft landing hero.
how: The stems draw themselves upward, leaves unfold, and each bud pops and opens with a burst of sparkles.
Move your pointer: the scene shifts in depth and the flowers lean toward you.
Tap a flower (or Tab to it and press Enter) to make it swing, sparkle and shed petals; tap the sky and the fireflies gather there.
Type a name and the note updates; press Grow again to replay.
With reduced motion the flowers appear already in bloom and nothing drifts or sways.
